title: The Fruit vs. The Finish Line
headline: How You Know a Disciple Is Growing
tagline: Jesus never invited us to admire His life. He invited us to continue it.
seo_title: How Do You Know a Disciple Is Growing? John 15:16 | TheWrkShop
seo_description: Jesus didn't say they'd know us by what we know, but by our fruit. A devotional on John 15:16 about abiding, being sent and fruit that lasts.
verse_text: I chose you and appointed you so that you might go and bear fruit — fruit that will last.

scriptures.text: I chose you and appointed you so that you might go and bear fruit — fruit that will last.
By their fruit you will recognize them.

items: “By this everyone will know you are My disciples…. if you know enough.”
Trees don’t struggle to announce they’re alive.
Even Jesus connects abiding to sending.
Fruit was never intended to stay on the branch.
And every seed carries another future tree.
This is how the Kingdom expands.

blocks.text: If someone followed my life for the past six months, would they become more like Jesus?

items: Not so we could become impressive.
But so we could become useful.
Not so we could collect knowledge.
But so we could multiply life.
Jesus never invited us to admire His life.
He invited us to continue it.
